content.title: Why KULR Technology Stock Is Plummeting Today
content.summary: After the market closed last Friday, KULR announced that it will carry out a reverse stock split.  KULR will implement an 8-for-1 reverse stock split on June 23.  The reverse split will help KULR keep trading on its current exchange, but some investors are seeing negative signs in the move.
